title: Termu-inator L0 local gate contract
rationale: L0 is the local regression lane defined in docs/verification-lanes.ko.md. It runs on a developer machine or CI runner and decides whether a tree is fit to go to the device. It does not replace the S22U device acceptance (L2), which stays mandatory by the user's 2026-10-23 decision. This file was created on 2026-09-30 as a device-free completion contract and was repositioned as L0 on 2026-11-10; the criteria and thresholds are unchanged.

blocking_criteria.description: The full in-repo test suite passes with zero failures and zero errors.
blocking_criteria.replaces: Nothing on the device. Local correctness only.

blocking_criteria.description: The full observe->act->verify loop runs end-to-end against a REAL headless browser (Chrome/Chromium/Firefox) driving the deterministic in-repo FixtureSite, using the production ObservationEngine, ActionRiskClassifier, element bindings, and CDP client. This exercises real DOM semantics, real form-effect counting, stale node-identity replacement, unavailable/hidden targets, challenge (login/OTP) takeover detection, prompt-injection inertness, and lost-response replay safety.
blocking_criteria.replaces: Nothing on the device. A desktop Chrome run is not evidence for Termux Chromium or Firefox on Android.

blocking_criteria.description: Records the repository identity (git commit SHA + working-tree hash) the verdict was produced from. A dirty tree still passes: this is an identity record, not a cleanliness check. The clean-commit requirement is enforced in L2 by scripts/final_verify.py.
blocking_criteria.replaces: Nothing. L2 keeps its own commit, tree and wheel binding.

informational_criteria.description: Displays a device report if one was dropped next to this file. Device results are judged in the L1/L2 lanes, never here. 'not_run' in this gate says nothing about device acceptance, which remains mandatory for alpha.
